en.headline: Suspect in HK$7 million airport gold robbery arrested after Tate’s Cairn Tunnel crash
en.dek: A 21-year-old man linked to the June gold-bar heist was detained after crashing inside the tunnel early Tuesday; police also seized suspected drugs worth about HK$70,000.
body: Police have arrested a 21-year-old man believed to be a key figure in the HK$7 million gold-bar robbery at Hong Kong International Airport in June after he crashed his private car inside Tate’s Cairn Tunnel in the early hours of Tuesday.

Officers said the man was driving towards Sha Tin around 3 a.m. when he collided with an oncoming vehicle. He sustained a leg injury but refused hospital treatment and was arrested at the scene. Two occupants of the other car were taken to Prince of Wales Hospital with injuries.

Investigators recovered about 66 grams of suspected cocaine, five e-cigarette cartridges believed to contain etomidate and drug paraphernalia valued at roughly HK$70,000 from the driver and his vehicle. He was also found to be driving without a licence or third-party insurance.

Police identified him as a suspect in the 18 June robbery in which a courier was attacked with knives in an airport car park and six gold bars were stolen. The arrest brings the total number of people detained over the case to 18. The man is expected to face six charges including conspiracy to rob and drug trafficking when he appears at Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts on Wednesday.

zh.headline: 機場劫金條案再拘一人 大老山隧道撞車後落網
zh.dek: 一名21歲男子被指與6月機場停車場劫去約700萬元金條案有關，周二凌晨在大老山隧道撞車後被捕，並檢獲約7萬元懷疑毒品。
body: 警方周二凌晨在大老山隧道拘捕一名21歲男子，指他與6月18日香港國際機場停車場劫去約700萬元金條案有關。
警方表示，該名男子約凌晨3時駕駛私家車往沙田方向行駛期間與迎面車輛相撞，他腿部受傷但拒絕送院，當場被捕。另一輛車的兩名乘客受傷，送往威爾斯親王醫院治理。
調查人員在男子及其車上檢獲約66克懷疑可卡因、五支懷疑含有依托咪酯的電子煙彈及吸毒工具，估計總值約7萬港元。他亦被發現無牌駕駛及沒有第三者保險。
警方指該男子是機場劫金案的主要涉案人之一，案件累計已有18人被捕。他料被控串謀行劫及販運危險藥物等六項罪名，周三在九龍城裁判法院提堂。
